verdict.rationale: Google documents cross-platform use: a device compatibility table covering Android and iOS (iPhones on iOS 13.3+), Linux setup via udev rules, and use with any site supporting FIDO CTAP1. A community user confirms it works with Firefox on Linux. However, no catalog of supported services is published, only a generic pointer to FIDO-compatible sites, and one hands-on report saw a Chrome-only error on Mac. missing for 10: a published compatibility catalog of supported services, documented browser support matrix across OSes, consistent independent corroboration of non-Chrome browser support.
